decision_rule: Publish a signal only if the coefficient is positive, the 95% interval excludes zero, and the pre-report movement is not the majority of it
have: Official injury report contents (4 clubs, Week 10, 2026-11-14)
lack: Every price, at every timestamp, for every game
question: Does the market move on the official injury report, or does it move first?
required_inputs: Timestamped opening and closing prices for the same game (price store, req 1)
The exact publication timestamp of the official injury report
At least one full season of both, aligned to kickoff
status: BLOCKED — cannot be computed without a price archive
test_statistic: regress the signed line movement (close - open) on the injury-status change, controlling for the result; report n, the coefficient, and the share of movement that precedes the report
why_it_matters: If the line moves before the official report, the report is not the information source and an injury-based signal cannot beat the close. If the line moves after, the size and timing of that move is the edge.
